newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet gains as NYMEX takes off, diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet gains as NYMEX takes off, diffs mixed.

text.p: Spot jet fuel prices shot higher Friday, rebounding from the lows made earlier in the week, though differentials ended the day mixed.
Outright prices surged higher on the back of the 3-cent NYMEX rally, as the futures continued their volatile trading.

In New York Harbor, prompt 54-grade jet fuel was talked between 1.50 to 1.75 cents over the screen, a dip of about 0.25 cent on the day. However, 55-grade prompt barrels changed hands at 3.00 cents over NYMEX, a gain of nearly 0.50 cent.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade diffs held steady Friday, though prompt 55-grade barrels slipped to between 0.75 to 1.0 cents under.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
